recentItems.title: Ongoing Atrocities in Iran
recentItems.description:
In Iran, an average of one protester per week has been sent to the gallows since March. Scores of protesters remain at imminent risk of execution.

At the UN Human rights Council this week, Human Rights Watch spoke about the ongoing atrocities Iranians are facing, including possible war crimes by Israel and the US.

recentItems.title: Australia: 25 Years of Abusive Offshore Detention
recentItems.description:
"I was not counted as a human being. I was counted, like a number, like ‘ah 16!’. They never called me by my name."

Since 2001, Australia has forcibly transferred more than 5,000 asylum seekers to offshore detention. The offshore detention policy has caused profound harm to men, women, and children seeking refuge.

recentItems.title: "Solwata" at Venice Film Festival
recentItems.description:
On every inhabited continent, communities are being displaced by the climate crisis. But Solomon Islands, a country in the Pacific, is among the first and worst affected.

Human Rights Watch partnered with Solomon Islands communities, NowHere Media and Agog to create the immersive documentary, "Solwata", which premiered at the Venice Film Festival.

recentItems.title: Iran: Ongoing Unlawful Execution Campaign Against Protesters
recentItems.description:
Iranian authorities are unlawfully executing protesters and political dissidents on a weekly basis, a relentless attack on the right to life, Human Rights Watch and the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center for Human Rights in Iran said today.

recentItems.title: South Korea: Systemic Gender, Age Discrimination at Work
recentItems.description:
Women in South Korea face systemic gender discrimination at every stage of their working lives, Human Rights Watch said in a report released today. These adverse impacts accumulate as women get older, and are compounded by systemic age discrimination, resulting in harm to their physical and mental health.

recentItems.title: 9 years on, Rohingya are still waiting for justice and accountability
recentItems.description:
In Myanmar, Rohingya are now oppressed by both the military and 
the Arakan Army, an ethnic armed group. Those who flee the country face dangerous journeys and living conditions, and are barred from lawful work and recognized education.
